reasons: applicability_requirement:Require FY2024 total revenue comparable with FY2025 total revenue, including reserve-income in both years; review annual period/edition consistency and reserve-yield/USDC-volume business applicability before interpreting growth.

applicability_requirement:Require FY2025 consolidated gross profit and total revenue; review whether reported cost classification includes distribution and transaction costs and whether gross margin meaningfully describes reserve-income economics.

applicability_requirement:Require FY2025 consolidated cost of revenue and total revenue; review distribution and transaction cost classification, sign and matching scope before deriving gross profit for this reserve-income issuer.

applicability_requirement:Require FY2025 consolidated net income and total revenue; review consolidated versus parent attribution, tax and non-operating items and reserve-income applicability; do not substitute operating income.

applicability_requirement:Require FY2025 consolidated operating cash flow and cash PPE purchases with matching period, edition and cash-outflow sign; review token-holder reserve/customer flows and restricted cash before treating the result as issuer-discretionary cash.

applicability_requirement:Require FY2025 consolidated operating cash flow, cash PPE purchases and total revenue with matching period/edition/sign; review token-holder reserve flows, restricted cash and reserve-income denominator applicability.

applicability_requirement:Require FY2025 year-end current assets and current liabilities; review classification of segregated USDC reserves, token-holder obligations and restricted versus issuer-available assets before approving liquidity applicability.

applicability_requirement:Require FY2025 year-end current assets and current liabilities; review segregated reserve/token-holder balance classification and issuer-available working capital scope before interpreting their difference.

applicability_requirement:Require FY2025 consolidated net income and comparable opening 2024-12-31 and closing 2025-12-31 total assets; review period/edition consistency and whether token-holder reserve assets make the consolidated asset denominator meaningful.
